name: local-llm-mcp
description: Offload code-shaped work (generation, review, refactoring, test-writing) to a local LLM: Ollama, llama-server, vLLM or LM Studio. File-aware tools read files server-side to save context. Includes an optional Read-gate hook that nudges Claude Code toward those tools. Fork of Jadael/OllamaClaude (AGPL-3.0).
